Layoffs are happening. Jobs don’t feel as secure. AI is changing the way we work. And a lot of people are realizing they may need more than one stream of income.

I want to encourage you to think about what’s already in your hands.

What do you know?

Look at your bank statement. I'll wait.

ChatGPT Plus: $20. Midjourney: $30. ElevenLabs: $22. Suno: $24. A video AI: $95. Every single month. That's $211/month — over $2,500 a year — for tools that don't even talk to each other.

And here's the part nobody says out loud: YOU are the glue. You're the one copying the script out of ChatGPT, pasting it into the voiceover tool, downloading the audio, uploading it to the video tool, exporting, re-uploading... You're not using AI. You're doing unpaid project management for seven different AIs.

Supercool is the first AI that does the entire job in one workflow:

🎵 Music — full tracks, with vocals or instrumental 🎬 Video — generated, edited, finished 🎙️ Voiceover — natural voices, even cloned ones 📸 Photos — generation and editing 💻 Code — real, working code ✍️ Scripts — ads, videos, books, all of it 🧠 A full LLM — everything ChatGPT does, built in

Ask Claude to make you a song. It can't. Ask GPT to produce your video. It won't. They're brilliant chatbots that hand the job back to you half-finished.

Supercool doesn't hand the job back. It finishes it. Idea → script → voiceover → visuals → final video. One tab. One workflow. Done.

$74/month. Every tool. One workflow. You just cut your AI bill by 65%.

No AI tool beats Supercool. Not Claude. Not GPT. Nothing.
